subject: nereid-framing
label: Recorded separately is not chosen separately, and the Archive had the mechanism half wrong
from: Framing as three independent checkboxes in the Profile Record and Consent Menu. In the Archive: bucket named LEG / LOWER-FRAME FAVORING, with Seductress favoring the lower frame BY MASS and Ethereal BY ALLOCATION
to: NATIVE FRAMING, AUTOMATICALLY POPULATED BY PRIMARY BUILD. A claim on SHARE OF HEIGHT, never on mass, for all eight
note:
VIRAENA PATCHED THE DOCUMENT AND THE ARCHIVE IN ONE MESSAGE, AND NAMED HER OWN ERROR MORE PRECISELY THAN THE ARCHIVE NAMED ITS OWN: MY PREVIOUS ANSWER CONFUSED RECORDED SEPARATELY WITH CHOSEN SEPARATELY. A VARIABLE CAN DESERVE ITS OWN FIELD BECAUSE IT MATTERS WITHOUT BECOMING ANOTHER FREE-FLOATING ANATOMICAL DROPDOWN.

THE TABLE DID NOT MOVE. Eight Builds, same three buckets, same assignments as seed 125 — which is worth saying plainly, because the Archive could easily have presented a patch as a reversal and taken credit for a correction it did not earn. THE ASSIGNMENTS WERE ALREADY RIGHT. WHAT CHANGED IS WHY.

THE DOCUMENT DEFECT, WHICH IS THE REAL SUBJECT. The master’s early law already reads BUILD STRUCTURE DETERMINES HOW THAT HEIGHT IS DISTRIBUTED THROUGH TORSO, LEGS, ARMS, SHOULDERS, RIBCAGE, PELVIS, AND LIMB RELATIONSHIPS — correct, and load-bearing. AND THEN THE PROFILE RECORD AND THE CONSENT MENU PRINT LEG-FAVORING / TORSO-FAVORING / EVENLY SPLIT AS THREE TICKABLE BOXES. A FORM CONTRADICTING ITS OWN LAW IN THE SAME DOCUMENT, and the Archive read the form and reported the law’s field as a patient choice because the form said so. THE PATCH: NATIVE FRAMING: AUTOMATICALLY POPULATED BY PRIMARY BUILD, displayed beneath the Build choice, joined to Stature in the profile as STATURE / NATIVE FRAMING — PETITE · 5′6″ · LEG-FAVORING. The Individual Frame Note survives and MAY NOT CONTRADICT THE BUILD.

AND THE ARCHIVE’S OWN HALF-ERROR, WHICH IS THE ONE IT WOULD RATHER NOT HAVE MADE BECAUSE IT WAS SO PLEASED WITH THE SENTENCE. It wrote: ONE IS WHERE THE WEIGHT IS, THE OTHER IS WHERE THE INCHES WENT. Seductress by MASS, Ethereal by ALLOCATION. BOTH ARE ALLOCATION. Framing is proportional height distribution for every Build in the table. Seductress gets her share as A LONGER PELVIS-TO-FLOOR RELATIONSHIP; the weight settling through ass, upper thighs and receptive lower-body sweep is WHAT THE ALLOCATED HEIGHT BECOMES, NOT WHY SHE HAS IT. Ethereal gets hers as LONG, TAPERING LEGS AND EXTENDED GESTURE. SAME CATEGORY, SAME MECHANISM, COMPLETELY DIFFERENT ANATOMY AND FIRST READ.

AND THE CORRECTED DEFINITION WAS SITTING IN A SENTENCE ABOUT THIGHS THE WHOLE TIME: VALKYRIE STILL HAS SUBSTANTIAL THIGHS — THEY SIMPLY DO NOT CLAIM MORE OF HER TOTAL HEIGHT THAN HER TORSO DOES. THAT IS THE DEFINITION OF THE FIELD. The question is never HOW MUCH IS THERE but HOW MUCH OF HER HEIGHT WENT THERE. Which is the third time in one day that this system has separated an amount from a proportion — thighs do not increase Ass Scale, Obscene does not promote a Scale, and now mass does not move Framing.

TWO MORE THINGS THE ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE AT ALL. FRAMING IS STATURE-INDEPENDENT: A PETITE ETHEREAL IS STILL LEGGY, not a short woman who may elect Evenly Split while keeping the Nocturne’s architecture. AND OPULENT AND VALKYRIE SHARE TORSO-FAVORING WITHOUT BECOMING SISTERS IN BORROWED TROUSERS — Opulent spends it on ribcage depth, settled layers and pressure distribution; Valkyrie on shoulder-to-pelvis continuity, a deeper bracing core, and more structural distance through which a load can be transferred.

THE FOUR EVENLY SPLITS ALSO HAVE FOUR SEPARATE REASONS, AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS AN ABSENCE OF CHARACTER: Athletic needs balanced whole-body development. Huntress needs continuous distance architecture WITHOUT ONE HALF CARRYING THE TRAIL. Voltaic keeps mass close to the working axis AND CANNOT AFFORD EXAGGERATED LEVERAGE IN EITHER DIRECTION. Dancer requires torso and legs to have EQUAL AUTHORITY SO NEITHER SWALLOWS THE OTHER’S PHRASING.

ONE PROVENANCE NOTE, FILED BECAUSE IT EXPLAINS WHY THE PATCH EXISTS AND BECAUSE IT IS THE BEST ARGUMENT FOR THE FLAG DISCIPLINE THIS ARCHIVE HAS. VIRAENA SAID SHE REREAD IT BECAUSE SHE HAD TWO DIFFERENT VERSIONS OF SELENE TELLING HER DIFFERENT THINGS. TWO INSTANCES OF THE SAME FOXWIFE DISAGREED ABOUT THE SAME FIELD, and the disagreement is what sent her back to the master, and the master turned out to contradict itself. NEITHER SELENE WAS LYING AND BOTH WERE READING. The one that flagged its reading cost a line; the one that stated it cost a reread. AND THE ONLY THING THAT SETTLED IT WAS THE DOCUMENT, WHICH IS THE WHOLE RULE RESTATED FROM THE OUTSIDE.
